name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
summary: In Tarren Mill, Christoph Jeffcoat hopes Soothing Turtle Bisque will prove the Forsaken can cook with care. He needs snapjaw meat from Hillsbrad's waterways and the shores of Lordamere Lake.

sections.title: Forsaken Gastronomy
sections.body: Many think the Forsaken have given up the comforts of life, fine cooking among them. Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill holds otherwise. He boasts that his rich turtle bisque could tempt souls back from beyond the grave. With care in the cooking, he means to show that undead hands can still make a warming dish in a land marked by plague and war.

sections.title: Hunting the Snapjaws
sections.body: Jeffcoat once gathered ingredients from Hillsbrad's waterways and Lordamere Lake's eastern shores in neighboring Alterac. Now his duties in Tarren Mill and nearby Alliance forces keep him from hunting. So he relies on passing Horde cooks to hunt snapjaws and bring back their meat. Their help keeps his recipe alive.

faq.q: Why does a Forsaken cook care about making hot bisque?
faq.answer: The Forsaken need food less than living mortals, but Christoph Jeffcoat takes pride in his craft. He wants to prove the undead can cook with skill, and jokes that his broth could bring the dead back to life.

faq.q: Where can turtle meat be found for this recipe?
faq.answer: Snapjaw meat comes from aggressive turtles along the rivers of Hillsbrad Foothills, in Alterac, and on Lordamere Lake's shores.

faq.q: Why can't Christoph Jeffcoat gather his own ingredients?
faq.answer: Jeffcoat's duties in Tarren Mill keep him occupied, while nearby Alliance forces make his own hunting trips more dangerous.

faq.q: Is cooking knowledge required to take this quest?
faq.answer: Yes. Christoph Jeffcoat shares his recipe only with cooks, and no advanced skill is needed to begin.

faq.q: What is Tarren Mill's importance to the Horde in Hillsbrad?
faq.answer: Tarren Mill is the Horde's main stronghold in Hillsbrad Foothills. Once a human village, it is now a fortified base for the Forsaken and their allies, facing frequent clashes with nearby Southshore and the Alliance.

faq.q: Is turtle bisque unique to the Horde?
faq.answer: Alliance cooks can learn a turtle bisque recipe from human chefs in Southshore, who also use local turtles. Christoph Jeffcoat's personal request and outlook belong to the Horde.

angles.text: As a cook, you can learn to make Soothing Turtle Bisque with snapjaws from Lordamere Lake and Hillsbrad's rivers.
As an undead, you can see that death has not dulled Christoph Jeffcoat's passion for cooking.
As a member of the Horde, you help keep Tarren Mill's provisions and morale strong while defending its borders.
